title: A Theory-Based Explainable Deep Learning Architecture for Music Emotion
authors: Hortense Fong; Vineet Kumar; K. Sudhir
eligible_reason: Explainable CNN classifier of time-varying emotional response to music, plus a lab experiment on ad insertion (emotional congruence vs contrast) analyzed with cross-sectional OLS (HC3). No DiD or event-study design.
design_notes: 1_Model: CNN training and testing (PyTorch, SHAP). 2_Lab_Experiment/b_experiment_regression.py: sm.OLS(skip / recall / log_ad_view_time ~ condition indicators).fit(cov_type='HC3').
data_files: ReplicationFiles/1_Model/1_RawData (DEAM and Soundtracks songs and annotations)
data_files_note: Public music-emotion datasets (DEAM, Soundtracks) and the lab-experiment regression data shipped.
data_provenance_note: Authors' own lab and model data.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
